level.why: 口語產品示範，以祈使句與簡單句為主，並有 so、which 引導的補充說明；字彙包含 secure、angle、cushion 等產品操作詞彙，步驟順序清楚，屬 B1+ 程度。

passage:
Let's start with everyday use.

First, press the Latch Angle Adjustment button to rotate the LATCH connectors out. Then, use the connectors to secure the mini base to the car seat.

There are two Latch Angle Adjustment buttons, one on each side of the base. They're connected, so you only need to press one to release the mechanism. This means you don't have to reach across to the other side, which can be harder to reach when you're installing the base in the car.

Once the mini base is installed, simply click the infant car seat into place.

You can then press the Latch Angle Adjustment button again to adjust the angle of the base, so it fits better against the car seat cushion and backrest.

When you need to take the baby out, just press the Mini Base Release button at the back of the car seat, then lift the infant car seat off the base.

The mini base stays in the car, ready for next time.

So, you don't have to set up the LATCH connectors every time. You can simply click the infant car seat in and out, just like with a traditional car seat base.
zh:
我們先從日常使用開始說明。

首先，按下 Latch Angle Adjustment（接頭角度調整）按鈕，將 LATCH 接頭轉出來。接著，使用這些接頭把迷你底座固定在汽座上。

底座兩側各有一個 Latch Angle Adjustment 按鈕，共兩個。它們是相連的，所以你只要按其中一個就能釋放機構。這表示你不必伸手到另一側去按，而在車內安裝底座時，另一側可能更難碰到。

迷你底座安裝好之後，只要把嬰兒汽座卡入定位即可。

接著你可以再按一次 Latch Angle Adjustment 按鈕來調整底座的角度，讓它更貼合汽座的坐墊與椅背。

需要把寶寶抱出來時，只要按下汽座後方的 Mini Base Release（迷你底座釋放）按鈕，再把嬰兒汽座從底座上提起即可。

迷你底座會留在車上，準備好下次使用。

所以，你不必每次都重新設定 LATCH 接頭。你只要把嬰兒汽座卡進、卡出就行了，就像使用傳統汽座底座一樣。

questions.q: Why don't users have to reach across to the other side of the base?
opts: The buttons are located at the back of the car seat.
The mini base is attached to the car seat permanently.
The two buttons are connected, so pressing one is enough.
The car seat can be installed without using any buttons.
why: 錯誤：Mini Base Release 按鈕才在汽座後方，與這兩個角度調整按鈕無關。
錯誤：文中說底座是用接頭固定到汽座上，並非永久固定。
正解：兩個 Latch Angle Adjustment 按鈕是相連的，只需按其中一個就能釋放機構。
錯誤：文中需要按按鈕才能將接頭轉出，並非不用任何按鈕。

questions.q: How can users take the baby out of the car?
opts: Press the Mini Base Release button on the car seat and lift the car seat off the base.
Press both Latch Angle Adjustment buttons at the same time.
Rotate the LATCH connectors back into the base.
Remove the mini base from the vehicle first.
why: 正解：講者說按下汽座後方的 Mini Base Release 按鈕，再把汽座從底座上提起。
錯誤：Latch Angle Adjustment 按鈕用於轉出接頭與調整角度，不是用來取下汽座。
錯誤：取出寶寶時不需要轉回接頭，底座仍留在車上。
錯誤：迷你底座會留在車上，不必先移除。

questions.q: Why does the speaker mention pressing the Latch Angle Adjustment button again?
opts: To release the infant car seat from the base
To rotate the LATCH connectors out
To lock the two buttons together
To help the base fit better against the car seat cushion and backrest
why: 錯誤：釋放汽座是靠 Mini Base Release 按鈕，不是這個按鈕。
錯誤：轉出 LATCH 接頭是第一次按按鈕時做的事，不是再按一次的目的。
錯誤：兩個按鈕本來就是相連的，不需要另外鎖在一起。
正解：再按一次按鈕可調整底座角度，讓它更貼合汽座的坐墊與椅背。

questions.q: Parents should check that the car seat is ______ secured before every trip.
opts: secure
securely
securing
security
why: 錯誤：形容詞 secure 不能修飾過去分詞 secured，需要用副詞。
正解：副詞 securely 修飾過去分詞 secured，表示「牢固地固定好」。
錯誤：securing 是動名詞或現在分詞，無法修飾 secured。
錯誤：security 是名詞，不能放在此處修飾分詞。

questions.q: The base is easy to install ______ it does not require any special tools.
opts: although
despite
because
unless
why: 錯誤：although 表讓步，與「不需要特殊工具所以容易安裝」的因果關係不符。
錯誤：despite 是介系詞，後面不能接完整子句。
正解：because 引導原因子句，說明容易安裝是因為不需要任何特殊工具。
錯誤：unless 表「除非」，語意不通。

questions.q: Customers can choose ______ the standard base and the travel base.
opts: between
among
within
through
why: 正解：between A and B 表示「在 A 與 B 之間選擇」，用於兩個選項。
錯誤：among 用於三者以上，且不與 and 連接兩個選項搭配。
錯誤：within 表「在……範圍內」，不用於選擇兩項。
錯誤：through 表「穿過、透過」，語意不符。

presentation_phrases.meaning: 我們先從日常使用開始說明。
presentation_phrases.usage: 簡報中進入第一個說明項目時使用，Let's start with... 語氣自然，能清楚標示接下來的主題。

presentation_phrases.phrase: First, press the Latch Angle Adjustment button to rotate the LATCH connectors out.
presentation_phrases.meaning: 首先，按下 Latch Angle Adjustment 按鈕，將 LATCH 接頭轉出來。
presentation_phrases.usage: 示範操作步驟時使用，First 帶出第一步，press + 按鈕 + to + 原形動詞 說明按鈕的作用。

presentation_phrases.phrase: Then, use the connectors to secure the mini base to the car seat.
presentation_phrases.meaning: 接著，使用這些接頭把迷你底座固定在汽座上。
presentation_phrases.usage: 接續上一步驟時使用，Then 是順序轉換詞，use A to + 原形動詞 表示用某物完成某事。

presentation_phrases.phrase: They're connected, so you only need to press one to release the mechanism.
presentation_phrases.meaning: 它們是相連的，所以你只要按其中一個就能釋放機構。
presentation_phrases.usage: 說明設計如何讓操作更簡單時使用，so you only need to... 點出結果，only 強調步驟很少。

presentation_phrases.phrase: This means you don't have to reach across to the other side.
presentation_phrases.meaning: 這表示你不必伸手到另一側去按。
presentation_phrases.usage: 說明設計帶來的使用好處時使用，This means... 把設計特色轉為使用者利益，don't have to 表示「不必」。

presentation_phrases.phrase: When you need to take the baby out, just press the Mini Base Release button, then lift the infant car seat off the base.
presentation_phrases.meaning: 需要把寶寶抱出來時，只要按下 Mini Base Release 按鈕，再把嬰兒汽座從底座上提起即可。
presentation_phrases.usage: 說明特定情境下的連續操作時使用，When you need to... 點出情境，just ... then ... 讓兩個動作銜接清楚。

presentation_phrases.phrase: So, you don't have to set up the LATCH connectors every time.
presentation_phrases.meaning: 所以，你不必每次都重新設定 LATCH 接頭。
presentation_phrases.usage: 總結產品帶來的便利時使用，So 帶出結論，every time 強調每次都省事。

presentation_phrases.phrase: Let me walk you through the steps.
presentation_phrases.meaning: 讓我帶各位一步步看操作流程。
presentation_phrases.usage: 在示範前引導聽眾進入步驟說明時使用，walk you through 表示「逐步帶著你了解」，常用於產品示範或教學。
